entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A gorgon created by Jace Beleren from his best qualities, who becomes his student, a Strixhaven student, and the first planeswalker to ignite after the Desparkening when Jace gifts her his spark.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker and telepath who created Tam as a backup plan and pursued a perfect Multiverse in the Echoverse until his death.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon and Jace's lover, whom Tam conspires with to stop the Theorist and later visits on Vryn.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: The Oracle of Arcavios, kidnapped by Jace's plan and later abducted by the Dawning Archaic.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A faerie planeswalker who lures Tam and her classmates to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: A Strixhaven student who flies her friends across the Wanderwine.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A Strixhaven student kidnapped by an elven hunter on Lorwyn.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A Strixhaven student who travels with Tam to Glen Elendra.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: An elf from Lorwyn who joins Strixhaven's cross-planar program at Tam's suggestion.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: A kithkin who finds the students on Lorwyn and offers hospitality.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: The queen of the faeries who appears to be turning into Oona; Tam saves her.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Maralen's aide, sworn to kill her if she becomes Oona.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: An old companion of Maralen's found in the Stinkdrinker warren.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: The moon-headed elemental of Shadowmoor whose premature awakening floods the world with darkness.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: Isilu's opposite, brought by Abigale to restore balance.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker enlisted by Liliana Vess to rescue the students.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer and professor who enlists Ajani; an imprisoned version of her is freed by Tam in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: The leader of the Lorwyn elves who forced Kirol to pick dawnglow.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who suspected Jace of meddling in the Archaics' ritual.

entities.name: Dellian Fel
entities.description: A strict professor at Titan's Grave.

entities.name: Dawning Archaic
entities.description: An Archaic that attacks Titan's Grave and abducts Jadzi.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan, devourer of unstable planes, whom Tam contacts and who consumes the Echoverse.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: Jace's reality set up to replace the original Multiverse, consumed by Emrakul.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: The university on Arcavios where Tam studies; Quandrix College is one of its colleges.

entities.name: Hexhaven Academy
entities.description: The Echoverse academy where Tam trained as a telepath under Jace.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: The dual plane where Tam and her classmates are lured.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane to which the Theorist sends Tam, where she communes with Emrakul.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: The plane where Tam visits Vraska.

events.summary: Jace Beleren creates Tam by severing a portion of his own thoughts and giving them form.
events.quote: Tam was artificially created by The Theorist, Jace Beleren , when the telepath severed a portion of his own thoughts and gave them form.

events.summary: Jace sends Tam to Strixhaven to spy and advance his plan, including kidnapping Jadzi.
events.quote: to spy for him and accomplish what he needed to do to get his reality set up

events.summary: Tam watches Jace excise the doubting parts of his personality, which begins to disturb her.
events.quote: Obsessed with his vision of a perfect Multiverse, he began to excise the aspects of his personality that dared to cause him doubt

events.summary: Tam joins Strixhaven University as a cross-planar student, claiming to be from Shandalar.
events.quote: Tam eventually left Hexhaven, returning to the Multiverse, and joined Strixhaven University around 4564 AR as part of the cross-planar student initiative, claiming to be from Shandalar .

events.summary: Oko lures Tam and her classmates through an Omenpath to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.
events.quote: However, the faerie planeswalker Oko appeared and lured Tam, along with her classmates Abigale , Kirol , and Sanar , through an Omenpath to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor .

events.summary: The students accidentally wake Isilu, whose darkness floods the world.
events.quote: They found the moon-headed creature, the elemental Isilu , in a chamber beyond the carvings and accidentally woke it.

events.summary: The kithkin Brigid Baeli introduces herself and offers the students hospitality.
events.quote: She introduced herself as Brigid Baeli .

events.summary: Isilu turns Goldmeadow to Shadowmoor and the students flee; Kirol is kidnapped by an elven hunter.
events.quote: However, Isilu walked past the village, plunging a place that had been in Lorwyn for years into the darkness of Shadowmoor.

events.summary: Tam uses probability magic to make Rhys miss his attack on Maralen.
events.quote: but Tam used probability magic to make him miss his attack and fall out a window.

events.summary: Kirol, Sanar and Lluwen steal the dawnglow vial, saving Maralen and Tam from moonglow poison.
events.quote: Kirol, Sanar , and Kirol's new ally Lluwen snuck into the elven lines, stole the vial, and brought it back, saving Maralen and Tam's lives.

events.summary: Abigale returns with Eirdu; the two gods embrace and balance is restored.
events.quote: The two gods embraced, and balance was restored to the plane.

events.summary: At Tam's suggestion, Lluwen joins Strixhaven's cross-planar student program.
events.quote: At Tam's suggestion, Lluwen joined Strixhaven's cross-planar student program to escape the ruthless elven hierarchy of Lorwyn.

events.summary: The Dawning Archaic attacks Titan's Grave and abducts Jadzi.
events.quote: he and Tam witnessed the Dawning Archaic attack Titan's Grave and abduct Jadzi.

events.summary: Chandra confronts Tam and the group, blaming Jace Beleren for the Archaics' disruption.
events.quote: Tam was confronted by Chandra Nalaar , who believed that the disruption of the Archaics was due to the meddling of Jace Beleren .

events.summary: Tam pushes Jadzi into the wild magic nexus and jumps in herself; both reform in the warped Strixhaven of the Echoverse.
events.quote: Tam pushed Jadzi into the nexus of wild magic and bade the others a tearful farewell before jumping into it herself.

events.summary: Tam finds that Jace has become tyrannical and, learning that the Echoverse would destroy the Multiverse, doubts the plan; he sends her to Innistrad.
events.quote: The Theorist sensed her doubts and sent her to Innistrad to take measurements and to see the worst horrors that the imperfect Multiverse had to offer.

events.summary: On Innistrad Tam contacts Emrakul, who demands to be led to the Echoverse, and Tam severs the link in terror.
events.quote: Emrakul, a devourer of unstable planes, demanded that Tam lead her there, causing Tam to sever the link in terror.

events.summary: Tam conspires with Vraska to stop Jace and frees Liliana by throwing a raw chicken leg into her cell.
events.quote: She conspired with Vraska to stop him, then left for Hexhaven's kitchen.

events.summary: Liliana reanimates the chicken, escapes and kills her duplicate.
events.quote: The necromancer reanimated the chicken, freed herself, and killed her duplicate.

events.summary: Tam calls out to Emrakul, telling her there is a Multiverse that needs to be consumed.
events.quote: with greatly magnified telepathy called out again to Emrakul, telling her that there was a Multiverse which needed to be consumed.

events.summary: Emrakul partitions the two Multiverses and consumes the Echoverse.
events.quote: Back in her body, she looked up and watched Emrakul partition the two Multiverses, drawing the Echoverse into herself and consuming it.

events.summary: Tam receives Jace's planeswalker spark and his final message after his death, and planeswalks to Strixhaven.
events.quote: He had died and passed it on to her, along with a final psychic message asking her to continue his work and always try to make things better.

events.summary: Tam visits Vraska on Vryn after the end of the Echoverse.
events.quote: Some time after the end of the Echoverse, Tam visited Vraska on Vryn , hoping for her help deciding what to do.

relations.note: Tam was artificially created from a portion of Jace's thoughts.
relations.quote: Tam was artificially created by The Theorist, Jace Beleren , when the telepath severed a portion of his own thoughts and gave them form.
Tam trained in the Theorix school of Hexhaven Academy as a telepath, with Jace as her mentor.
The fact that his lover Vraska was also a gorgon may have been an influence on her species.

relations.note: Tam conspires with Vraska against the Theorist.
relations.quote: She conspired with Vraska to stop him, then left for Hexhaven's kitchen.

relations.note: Liliana Vess enlisted Ajani to rescue the students.
relations.quote: Ajani Goldmane , who had been enlisted by the class's professor Liliana Vess to rescue the students, entered the fray with Kirol in tow, holding off the elves.

relations.note: Chandra blamed Jace's meddling for the Archaics' disruption.
relations.quote: Tam was confronted by Chandra Nalaar , who believed that the disruption of the Archaics was due to the meddling of Jace Beleren .
Back in her body, she looked up and watched Emrakul partition the two Multiverses, drawing the Echoverse into herself and consuming it.
